Multi-Device Hub & Synchronization

Discover and control multiple WLED lights on your local network, switch targets seamlessly, or link all lights together with real-time UDP broadcast sync!

UDP Broadcast Group Sync

WLED Multi-Device Sync Protocol (Port 21324)
Broadcast Commands (Sync Send) Mirrors all color, brightness, effects & music sync to other WLED devices on LAN
Listen for Commands (Sync Receive) Allows this device to follow commands sent by other WLED remotes
